prompt: Determine the number of active Gmail users in India.

clarifications.answer: Use an age-wise split of the 140 crore population, applying internet penetration, email-usage penetration and an active-user rate to each band.
Take Gmail's share of active email users as about 85%.
Answer in crore active users (total email users ~28 Cr, Gmail ~24 Cr).

common_traps: Applying one internet-penetration rate across all ages instead of varying it by age band.
Confusing having internet access with actively using email, skipping the email-penetration step.
Forgetting to apply Gmail's market share, reporting total email users instead of Gmail users.

anchors.1: Guesses a number with no penetration-based build-up.
anchors.3: Applies internet penetration but not email usage or the active-user filter.
anchors.5: Chains age-band internet, email and active-user rates, then applies Gmail's share.

anchors.3: Segments ages but with one blanket penetration rate.
anchors.5: Segments by age with distinct internet, email and active-user rates per band.

anchors.1: Chains the penetration fractions incorrectly; lands far off.
anchors.3: Reaches a number with a slip, landing just outside 18-30 crore.
anchors.5: Carries the successive-fraction and share math cleanly, landing near 24 crore.

anchors.3: Mentions a check but does not complete it.
anchors.5: Cross-checks that ~24 crore Gmail users is a believable ~85% of ~28 crore active email users in India.
